notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms catalogue supports the record (county, elevation, standing). Two searches and the cached register pages found no Kennedy tower history. The OSM cache hit for Kennedy Lookout Tower is in Wisconsin and is unrelated. Kennedy may be a place or family name; not verified. Hornsby (catalogue HRT002) is another Hardeman County tower and is not used. The standing status is undated in the catalogue. The entry also carries the remark 'private, relocated from Middleton', which the first draft missed and the story now cites; the first draft's 'no further note' was wrong.
